name: Core: small open-economy gap model
summary: IS curve, Phillips curve and UIP for a small open economy. Every other brick plugs into it. Inputs from absent bricks fall back on the stubs below, so the core runs on its own.

requires.stub: exogenous path; contributes zero to the output gap beyond baseline
constant relative price (no energy cost channel)

checks: IRF signs to demand, supply, UIP and foreign shocks
stubbed inputs reproduce the stand-alone baseline
